entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I think I need to return something. I'm not really sure how it works. The website was a little confusing.

I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me which item you're calling about and what specifically is the issue? For instance, is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, um, it's the cycling shoes I bought. They just... they hurt. I think I got blisters the one time I tried them. And the things on the bottom... the cleats? I couldn't figure them out at all. It's all so complicated.
I'm sorry to hear the shoes weren't a good fit and were causing you blisters. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?
I think so... hold on. Okay, it's VF-8675309. I just want to send them back and get a refund. Can't you just help me with that? I find this whole process so overwhelming.
Of course, I'm here to make this as simple as possible. Let me just pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Ride cycling shoes, delivered about 56 days ago.
Is that bad? Am I too late? I told you I didn't understand the policy.

Not at all, you're perfectly fine. Our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at 56 days, you are well within that window. I can go ahead and process this return for you right now.
Oh! Really? That's... that's a huge relief. So I can get a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the box with the shoes inside, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Wow, okay. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've made this so much easier than I thought it would be.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
